notes: New: native login and registration are now handled inside the Mac client instead of redirecting to the web flow.
New: Live wallpaper details now include a compact video preview control with loading progress.
Changed: startup image loading is lighter. Wallpaper previews are decoded at UI-appropriate sizes, duplicate image requests are coalesced, and the in-memory cache is capped more conservatively.
Fixed: dark mode coin surfaces and the Home hero trade button now better match the Mac client's dark appearance.
Fixed: startup window chrome cleanup now runs once per window instead of repeatedly walking the AppKit view tree.
Fix: My Downloads now checks whether the local file actually exists. If the file was cleared from this Mac, the card returns to the normal Download action instead of showing as already downloaded.
Fix: multi-display auto-shuffle now re-syncs the selected wallpaper after the first apply pass, making secondary displays and Spaces less likely to remain on a previous wallpaper.
New: auto-shuffle timing can now be customized from My Downloads with common presets and a custom interval.
New: wallpaper card download and set-wallpaper buttons show an orange progress border while downloads are in progress.
Changed: auto-shuffle settings now live on My Downloads, next to the local wallpaper library they control.
Changed: clicking the menu-bar icon now opens the main app window directly, and the status icon uses a white template treatment.
Changed: Mac wallpaper feeds no longer apply local screen-size filtering by default. Explicit My Device filters still request device matching from the backend.
Fixed: auto-shuffle now applies the selected wallpaper to every connected display instead of only the primary screen.
New: full Dock-visible macOS app with Home, Discover, Weekly, Collections, Upload, Settings, and personal library pages while keeping the status-bar quick actions.
New: web-aligned wallpaper detail modal with preview, stats, palette, similar wallpapers, trade/download actions, progress, and set-wallpaper flows.
New: standalone Upload page with queue progress, pending/reviewing wallpapers, and processing states matching the web UI.
New: dynamic palette-mesh window background, page-specific skeleton placeholders, shared retry UI, and web-aligned dark appearance.
Changed: Discover and Home layouts now mirror the web more closely, including the device preview, category filters, card actions, and window chrome.
Changed: wallpaper lists are resolution-aware across the Mac client, hiding wallpapers that cannot satisfy the smallest connected display while keeping higher-resolution wallpapers visible.
Changed: download and set-wallpaper behavior is unified for already-downloaded wallpapers, normal images, macOS dynamic wallpapers, and video wallpapers.
Fixed: detail modal layout, similar-wallpaper row sizing, bottom clipping, full-screen card interaction, and several palette/background/chrome polish issues.
Fix: in the Latest column, the Set as wallpaper button on a wallpaper you'd already downloaded did nothing — it now applies it to your desktop.
Video wallpapers no longer appear in the Downloaded column (the mac client can't play them); they're hidden the same way the Latest list already did.

Fix: auto-rotate now reaches every display, including ones that were asleep at the rotation tick. The app listens for screen-wake / system-wake events and re-applies the current wallpaper so secondary monitors no longer get stuck on the previous image.
Diagnostics: wallpaper-apply now logs per-screen results to Console.app (subsystem com.wallpaperexchange.mac). Helps investigate reports of secondary monitors not picking up the new wallpaper.
AI-generated wallpapers now carry a violet AI chip in the top-left corner alongside the resolution / Mac chips, matching the web badge.
Self-update now shows real download progress — a floating panel with bytes / percentage / a working Cancel button, plus an 'Installing…' stage while the new bundle is being moved into place.
Fix: updater no longer feels frozen on slow networks. The previous build ran the download inside a modal alert with no visible feedback.
New: Launch at Login toggle in the status-bar right-click menu. Wallpaper Exchange can now start with your Mac so the wallpaper rotation never falls behind a reboot.
If you've moved the app outside /Applications the toggle will explain why macOS refused to register it.
New: the app now checks for new releases on every launch and offers a one-click upgrade — no more dragging a .dmg into /Applications by hand.
New: right-click the status-bar icon for a menu with Check for Updates… and Quit.
Update prompts appear at most once per new version. Clicking Later silences the alert until the next release ships.

Fix: app failed to launch on any Mac other than the build machine — the SwiftPM resource bundle was packaged at the wrong path inside the .app, so Bundle.module trapped at startup. The 1.2.1 build was effectively broken on every fresh install; please re-download.
Installer DMG now opens as the standard drag-to-install window — app icon on the left, Applications shortcut on the right. No more wondering where to put the .app.
Editorial Archive redesign of the popover — frosted-glass paper backdrop, 720×700 surface, hairline-divided two-column body.
Latest and Downloaded columns sit side-by-side with their own filter pills (Dynamic, Shuffle).
Wallpaper tiles redesigned to 16:10 with hover-revealed action pills over a bottom-up gradient.
Active chip surfaces on whichever Downloaded wallpaper is currently applied to the desktop.
Redownload action on Downloaded rows whose local file is missing.
Reveal-in-Finder button on Downloaded — opens the local downloads folder.
Live shuffle status banner with a countdown to the next rotation.
Infinite scroll on both columns — prefetches the next page before you hit the bottom, with a Load more fallback and End marker.
Local disk usage indicator in the footer next to the version.
Fix: Latest list now returns the full wallpaper catalogue (was silently filtering by device resolution).
Fix: Downloaded list shows wallpapers immediately after download (same filter was hiding new entries).
Now ships as a universal binary — runs on both Apple Silicon and Intel Macs. Previous builds were arm64-only and silently failed to launch on Intel.
Bundle now carries a proper app icon in Finder, Launchpad and the DMG window.
Auto-rotate desktop wallpaper from your downloads every 4 hours, persists across launches.
One-tap Download & Set as Wallpaper from the discover feed.
Real download progress bar for large dynamic HEIC files.
Per-column macOS dynamic-only filter for Latest and Downloaded.
Downloaded list filters to wallpapers matching this Mac's resolution.
Menubar status icon now uses the brand logo.
Progressive image loading and in-memory cache — rows don't flash a loading state when you scroll back up.
Set Wallpaper auto-downloads on demand for wallpapers downloaded on another device.
Auth token moved out of Keychain — no more system permission prompt at launch.
Many UI fixes: hover button stability, post-login user info, stale state after sign out.
Menubar status bar app for browsing the Wallpaper Exchange feed.
Single-sign-on against the web session via wallxch:// URL scheme.
Per-row hover actions: Download and Download & Set as Wallpaper on the discover list, Set Wallpaper on the local downloads list.
In-row progress indicator while a download is in flight.
Open Web shortcut in the footer for jumping back to the full site.
Brand logo as the menubar status item icon.
